summary: Defines a way to encrypt data in the Cryptographic Message Syntax using a user-supplied password or other variable-length secret. Before this, the format had no provision for password-based encryption. It was replaced by RFC 3369 and RFC 3370.

eli5.summary: Normally a lock needs a special metal key. This lets you lock a message with a password you remember instead. It has been replaced by RFC 3369 and RFC 3370.

questions: encrypt with a password cryptographic message syntax
